Name: maple's baby blue eyes
Author: SqueakGames
Description:
[i][size=4]Description[/size][/i]
adds baby blue eyes, from the nemophila family of flowers, to stardew valley! they can be bought at pierre's and grow in 5 days.

[i][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/i]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]to install, simply extract this mod and it's requirements in your mods folder and you're good to go![/size][/color]

[size=4][i]Recommendations[/i][/size]
i recommend playing this mod with the mods below!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14061]wild flowers[/url]: makes flowers grow on wild grass
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's earthy recolor[/url]: i had this recolor in mind when choosing a color palette for the baby blue eyes
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30067]short grass for earthy recolor[/url]: makes the grass shorter, making it easier to spot wild baby blue eyes if playing with wild flowers
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]cornucopia artisan machines[/url]: adds more to do with baby blue eyes

[i][size=4]Future Plans[/size][/i]
i plan on making this mod a bit bigger, adding some more of my favorite flowers (and maybe recipes to go along with them). i would love to add a osmanthus tree, hyacinths, hydrangeas and more.

[size=4][i]Permissions[/i][/size]
[size=3]you're free to publish translations and recolors of this mod as long as they don't use ai generated/assisted content[/size]
[size=3]please don't use my assets on your mod without asking, and please don't upload my mod to other sites. [b]my mods are only on nexus!![/b][/size]

[size=4][i]Shout outs[/i][/size]
thank you concerned ape for making this lovely game, and thank you stardew modding wiki for teaching me how to add crops trough content patcher!
